_note: Loop and Learn's customizations (loopandlearn/customization), read 2026-11-13. dosing: LoopStack's reading of whether the patch changes what Loop doses or is told; those need a second confirmation (PRODUCT.md SAFE-3). offered:false is never committed (no_auth removes a safety feature). Shared by the main process (library.cjs) and the page (loopCustomizations.ts).

items.name: Future carbs up to 4 hours
items.what: Carb entries can be dated up to 4 hours ahead instead of 1.

items.name: Lower carb entry limits
items.what: Warns at 49 g and blocks over 99 g per entry.

items.name: Higher carb entry limits
items.what: Warns at 201 g and allows up to 300 g per entry.

items.name: Finer override insulin needs
items.what: Override insulin needs from 50% to 200% in 5% steps.

items.name: Two-hour lollipop
items.what: The lollipop absorption choice becomes 2 hours.

items.name: Therapy profiles
items.what: Save and load sets of therapy settings.

items.name: Basal lock
items.what: Holds basal delivery at the scheduled rate when glucose is high.

items.name: Negative insulin damper
items.what: Limits how much negative active insulin counts.

items.name: Longer remote window
items.what: Remote commands stay valid for 10 minutes.

items.name: Remote carb edits
items.what: A caregiver can edit or delete carbs from LoopFollow.

items.name: xDrip4iOS as a CGM
items.what: Use xDrip4iOS as Loop’s glucose source.

items.name: Now line
items.what: A line marking now on Loop’s charts.

items.name: Loop and Learn icon
items.what: The Loop and Learn app icon.

items.name: Meal history, days
items.what: Shows more days of meal history.

items.name: Meal history, a week
items.what: Shows a week of meal history.

items.name: CGM sensor notes
items.what: Adds sensor start and change notes to Nightscout.

items.name: No Face ID for bolus
items.what: Removes Face ID or passcode before a bolus or settings change.

items.name: LoopStack favorites
items.what: Adds the meals you chose in LoopStack to Loop’s favorites, once each. Manage them from the Meal response tile.
